services.label: What I Offer
services.title: My Services
services.description: I provide technical and digital services, including website development and management, technical support, and data administration, tailored to the needs of individuals and businesses.

items.title: Landing & Introductory Page Package
items.description: Designing and developing a responsive introductory page for a product, service, or startup, aligned with its visual identity and featuring contact options and basic search engine optimization (SEO).

items.title: Business Website Package
items.description: Developing professional websites for companies and businesses with two to five pages, responsive design, advanced contact forms, external service integrations, and search engine optimization for individual pages.

items.title: Custom Web Development Package
items.description: Developing tailored web solutions based on project requirements, including interactive interfaces, dashboards, and databases, with options for WordPress and e-commerce platforms.

items.title: Website Management
items.description: Managing website content, updating pages and information, organizing digital data, monitoring website performance, and resolving basic operational issues.

items.title: Technical & Systems Support
items.description: Supporting users of computers, software, and digital systems, diagnosing basic technical issues, tracking incidents, and providing appropriate guidance and solutions.

items.title: Data & Office Administration
items.description: Entering and reviewing data, organizing files and records, and preparing documents, spreadsheets, and reports using Microsoft 365 applications with accuracy and confidentiality.

header.title: Featured Projects
header.desc: A variety of website development projects built using modern web technologies.
